method: Two passes re-solved by hand: 5 random items per chapter file (19 chapters) plus 5 mock items (seed 3; 100 items), then 3 per file (seed 11; 60 items) after fixes. Every literature-subtopic stem checked by script to name its text, every MCQ checked for duplicate options, and every name-led option checked by script for verb gender agreement
fixes: situation MCQs ('किसका आचरण … के अनुरूप है?') put a masculine verb after a girl's name (e.g. 'इशिता हाथ के काम को अपमानजनक मानता है'); options now agree verb and participle with the actor's gender (5 items in the first sample)
'घर की याद' true/false lead said 'पिता के चित्रण' while the statement pool also covers the सावन address; lead widened to 'पिता के चित्रण और सावन के प्रसंग'

अपठित गद्यांश written question on lost water traditions could appear without the sentences it relies on ('इन परंपराओं'); passages now always include the sentences each written question needs and the sentences a chosen sentence leans on
note: Second sample found no wrong keys. Prose extracts and all अपठित texts are original; only public-domain verse (कबीर, मीरा) is quoted; modern poems (घर की याद, चंपा…, दुष्यंत की ग़ज़ल, अक्क महादेवी, पाश, निर्मला पुतुल) are paraphrased and marked as such.
